Name: Cash Out Your Bank Account
Author: Pandappuccino
Description:
It kind of bugged me how the farmer moves to Stardew Valley with pocket change and nothing else. I mean, surely they had some sort of savings in the bank before they moved right?

Well, this mod is basically just a small immersion nugget for myself, and I thought it would be fun to share it with others. After moving into your Grandpa's old cottage, you'll eventually receive a letter from Joja National Bank cashing out the contents of your account. By default, the letter is delivered on [b]Spring 2[/b], and contains [b]10,000 gold[/b]; you can define when to queue the letter to be delivered as well as how much it contains! Do you want to imply you had an account bursting at the seams, or that you only had pennies to your name? Do you want there to be some "administrative delays" preventing you from getting your money right away, or do you want Joja to seem at least somewhat efficient? It's all up to you!

[b]KNOWN ISSUES:
[/b][list]
[*]The letter will not be delivered on the date specified in the configuration, it will be delivered the following day. This is due to the way the eventing system is set up regarding dates; unfortunately I'm not entirely sure how to fix this without an ugly auto-run event.
[/list]
